sloka: खड्गप्रहाराभिहतो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः।आजघान त्रिशिरसं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७०.४२ ।।
transliteration: khaḍgaprahārābhihato hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ।ājaghāna triśirasaṁ talenorasi vīryavān ।। 6.70.42 ।।

translations.english: Heroic Hanuman hit by Trisira, attacked him with his palm on the chest.
